blurb: Apple builds security into its hardware, software, and services so that protections reinforce one another across its platforms. Apple-designed silicon and security hardware help protect the operating system and apps; signed software, sandboxing, encryption, and secure updates protect the device and its data; and services support protected communications, payments, and account access. Many safeguards, including device encryption and biometric authentication, are enabled by default so users and organisations can benefit from them without extensive configuration.
